beats.event: Grows up on Buck's Peak with a paranoid, anti-school father
Brother Shawn begins physically and emotionally abusing her
Finds first friendship and romance with Charles through theater
Tyler urges her to study for the ACT
Admitted to BYU at 17 on scholarship
College life alienates her; feels culturally lost
Distances from Charles under the weight of Shawn's abuse
Professors urge her toward graduate study abroad
Studies at King's College, Cambridge, under Steinberg
Gets vaccinated, breaking with her family's ideology
Learns Shawn is abusing his wife; parents deny it
Realizes her mother has never taken her side
Shawn threatens her life; family closes ranks against her
Panic attacks; a year of no contact with her parents
Completes her PhD in history at Cambridge
Accepts permanent estrangement to live as herself
